reviews.t: It is best choose for blonde
reviews.x: The fear of every blonde is to have a yellow or orange tint in her hair. This situation can be avoided if you use this set of shampoo and conditioner. Both of them have a lilac color and give the hair a snowy tint. If you unfortunately get a yellow tint after coloring your hair, this kit can help you fix this. It is also useful for the systematic maintenance and proper care of your white hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the purple shampoo and conditioner effectively remove yellow and brassy tones, leaving gray, blonde, and highlighted hair brighter and more natural-looking.
Reviewers frequently praise how soft, smooth, and shiny the product leaves their hair.
Several reviewers note the shampoo is thin and watery and requires using a lot of product.
Some reviewers warn the product is strongly pigmented and can tint hair purple if left on too long, especially on ash or platinum blonde.
Opinions on scent are mixed, with some loving the mild fragrance and others finding it too strong.

qa.q: Will this purple shampoo actually tone down the brassiness in my blonde hair?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it works for blondes and tones brassiness [2][5], while others warn it deposits purple color and can leave a purple tint rather than correcting brassiness [1][3][4][6].

claims.text: Some reviewers report it works well for blonde hair and gives great results [2][5].
Other reviewers say it turns hair purple or leaves a purple tint, especially on ash or platinum blonde [1][3][6].
One reviewer describes it as more of a color depositing shampoo than a brassiness corrector [4].

qa.q: Is it safe for color-treated or bleached hair?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the set as working well on blonde, bleached, and color-treated hair to remove yellow tones [1][2][3][4][6]. However, one reviewer notes it acts more as a color-depositing shampoo than a brassiness corrector [5].

claims.text: The set is described as useful for blonde and bleached hair to remove yellow or orange tints.
One reviewer says it is more of a color-depositing shampoo than a brassiness corrector.

qa.q: Does it dry out your hair or leave it feeling soft?
qa.answer: Reviews say it leaves hair soft and shiny [1][2], though one reviewer deducted a star because the conditioner could be more hydrating [4], and another with dry hair returned it [3].

claims.text: Leaves hair soft and smelling good
Leaves hair soft and shiny with no residue
Conditioner could be a little more hydrating
A reviewer with dry hair returned it

qa.q: How long do I need to leave it in for it to work?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is the scent strong or does it smell bad?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on scent strength: one says the scent is too strong [1], while others describe it as mild or nice-smelling [2][3][4]. No review says it smells bad.

claims.text: One reviewer found the scent too strong.
Other reviewers describe the scent as nice, mild, or better than other purple shampoos.
